importer_axis_contract.authority: installed Isaac Sim 4.5 URDF importer and PhysX USD schemas
importer_axis_contract.observed_importer_behavior: Isaac Sim warns that non-primary URDF axes are aligned to a PhysX X primary axis by rotating the imported body and joint local frames; in the generated USD, an unauthored physics:axis therefore means the PhysX X fallback
importer_axis_contract.runtime_requirement: Each Isaac dynamics validation must record the imported USD primary axis and local frame, reconstruct its zero-pose world axis, and verify directed alignment with this source contract
importer_axis_contract.source_interpretation: axis_world_zero_pose is computed from the current URDF kinematic chain; it is not inferred from the joint name and is not assumed to remain the authored USD primary axis

geometry.method: exact current-URDF FK, inertial origins, and collision vertices

canonicalization.finger_positions_and_targets: zeroed to prevent fixed-root numerical noise from selecting pose
canonicalization.nonfinger_positions: exact clamped settled_geometry values from source evidence
canonicalization.nonfinger_targets: raw released targets from source evidence

zero_pose_ground_support.method: collision mesh vertices within tolerance of the zero-pose minimum Z

nominal_pose_selection.selected: unproven transferred seed from invalidated gravity-static run, realigned to current collision geometry
nominal_pose_selection.selection_reason: the canonical pose completed a 3-second free-root release with zero falls and 0.63 mm drift, while all zero-pose variants fell near 1.2 seconds

stability_experiment_history.use: hypothesis history only; no recorded result promotes the current rabbit-ear lineage

reason.interpretation: remove the artificial free-fall and asymmetric impact before changing pose or gains

result.interpretation: initial impact improved materially, but zero-pose long-term stability did not pass

stability_experiments.scope: base spawn Z only; restore baseline ankle damping

stability_experiments.hypothesis: If the zero pose survives with explicit upper-body holding, compliant upper-body motion is causal; if support exit remains, the next experiment must change nominal posture/contact equilibrium

result.interpretation: broad upper-body authority injected energy and worsened stability

stability_experiments.scope: zero pose, ground alignment, lower-body gains, effort limits, and contact geometry unchanged

source_comparison.adaptation: retain Landau effort/velocity limits and all lower-body gains

attempts.reason: strict floating-point comparison rejected finger targets at most 0.00114611 rad above a zero upper limit

attempts.criterion_correction: contact force alone cannot close fixed-root load balance because the root constraint reaction was not measured; fixed-root contact load is diagnostic

fixed_root_load_contract.reason: the unmeasured kinematic root constraint may carry any residual weight reaction; contact force becomes gating only when summed with a measured constraint reaction

derivation.leg_seed: 0.5 * installed Isaac Lab G1 hip/knee/ankle flexion
derivation.selection: maximum signed COM distance inside the bilateral near-ground collision hull
derivation.upper_body_offsets_during_geometry_searc: zero; fixed-root settling derives only necessary offsets

geometry_candidate.method: exact current-URDF FK, inertial origins, and collision vertices

stability_experiments.hypothesis: A small collision-compatible crouch with centered COM and measured PD preload will avoid the zero-pose forward support exit without applying high authority to hands or fingers

limit_audit.policy: Only non-locomotion finger desired positions and PD targets within tolerance are clamped to the imported hard limit; raw and clamped values are recorded. Any action-joint violation or finger excess beyond tolerance remains a hard failure.

runtime_derivation.fixed_root_method: rewrite audited root pose and zero velocity before every settling step
runtime_derivation.release: restore free root at collision-derived ground-aligned height with zero velocity
runtime_derivation.released_pd_target: settled position + required torque / baseline stiffness
runtime_derivation.required_torque: mean applied actuator torque over the final settling window
runtime_derivation.settled_pose: mean joint positions over the final settling window

stability_experiments.scope: derive with pinned root and baseline low-authority PD, then release in the same Isaac process

stability_experiments.promotion_requirement: pass the exact 30-second passive gate and separate viewport proof with the 8,864-triangle asset
stability_experiments.scope: transferred pose seed, exact rabbit-ear mesh, free root, zero action/command

zero_pose_static_authority_audit.limitation: diagnoses joint holding compliance; it is not a floating-base contact inverse-dynamics solution
zero_pose_static_authority_audit.method: current URDF subtree gravity moments with the floating base held fixed
